arxiv-1904-07866.title: Engineering spin squeezing in a 3D optical lattice with interacting spin-orbit-coupled fermions
arxiv-1904-07866.creator: P. He, M. A. Perlin, S. R. Muleady, R. J. Lewis-Swan, R. B. Hutson, J. Ye, A. M. Rey
arxiv-1904-07866.description: Abstract One of the most important tasks in modern quantum science is to coherently control and entangle many-body systems, and to subsequently use these systems to realize powerful quantum technologies such as quantum-enhanced sensors. However, many-body entangled states are difficult to prepare and preserve since internal dynamics and external noise rapidly degrade any useful entanglement.

arxiv-2103-00638.title: Khavinson conjecture for hyperbolic harmonic functions on the unit ball
arxiv-2103-00638.creator: Adel Khalfallah, Fathi Haggui, Miodrag Mateljević
arxiv-2103-00638.description: Abstract . In this paper, we prove the Khavinson conjecture for hyperbolic harmonic functions on the unit ball. This conjecture was partially solved in [ 5 ] 1. introduction For \displaystyle n\geq 2 , let \displaystyle{\mathbb{R}}^{n} denote the \displaystyle n -dimensional Euclidean space.

arxiv-2110-15078.title: Relative Haagerup property for arbitrary von Neumann algebras
arxiv-2110-15078.creator: Martijn Caspers, Mario Klisse, Adam Skalski, Gerrit Vos, Mateusz Wasilewski
arxiv-2110-15078.description: Abstract . We introduce the relative Haagerup approximation property for a unital, expected inclusion of arbitrary von Neumann algebras and show that if the smaller algebra is finite then the notion only depends on the inclusion itself, and not on the choice of the conditional expectation.

arxiv-2206-09213.title: Local well-posedness result for a class of non-local quasi-linear systems and its application to the justification of Whitham-Boussinesq systems
arxiv-2206-09213.creator: Louis Emerald
arxiv-2206-09213.description: Abstract In this paper we prove a local well-posedness result for a class of quasi-linear systems of hyperbolic type involving Fourier multipliers. Among the physically relevant systems in this class is a family of Whitham-Boussinesq systems arising in the modeling free-surface water waves.

arxiv-2210-05151.title: UGformer for Robust Left Atrium and Scar Segmentation Across Scanners Thanks: This research is funded by XJTLU Research Development Funding 20-02-60. Computational resources used in this research are provided by the School of Robotics, XJTLU Entrepreneur College (Taicang), Xi’an Jiaotong-Liverpool U
arxiv-2210-05151.creator: Tianyi Liu, Size Hou, Jiayuan Zhu, Zilong Zhao, Haochuan Jiang*
arxiv-2210-05151.description: Abstract Thanks to the capacity for long-range dependencies and robustness to irregular shapes, vision transformers and deformable convolutions are emerging as powerful vision techniques of segmentation. Meanwhile, Graph Convolution Networks (GCN) optimize local features based on global topological relationship modeling.

arxiv-2307-01543.title: Degradation-aware data-enabled predictive control of energy hubs
arxiv-2307-01543.creator: Varsha Behrunani 1,2, Marta Zagorowska 1, Mathias Hudoba de Badyn 1, Francesco Ricca 1, Philipp Heer 2 and John Lygeros 1
arxiv-2307-01543.description: Abstract Mitigating the energy use in buildings, together with satisfaction of comfort requirements are the main objectives of efficient building control systems. Augmenting building energy systems with batteries can improve the energy use of a building, while posing the challenge of considering battery degradation during control operation.

arxiv-2310-16240.title: Mixture-of-Linguistic-Experts Adapters for Improving and Interpreting Pre-trained Language Models
arxiv-2310-16240.creator: Raymond Li, Gabriel Murray, Giuseppe Carenini
arxiv-2310-16240.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Raymond Li, Gabriel Murray, Giuseppe Carenini. In this work, we propose a method that combines two popular research areas by injecting linguistic structures into pre-trained language models in the parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) setting. In our approach, parallel adapter modules encoding different linguistic structures are combined using a novel Mixture-of-Linguistic-Experts architecture, where Gumbel-Softmax gates are used to determine the importance of these modules at each layer of the model.

arxiv-2406-12563.title: A Super-human Vision-based Reinforcement Learning Agent for Autonomous Racing in Gran Turismo
arxiv-2406-12563.creator: Miguel Vasco, Takuma Seno *, Kenta Kawamoto, Kaushik Subramanian, Peter R. Wurman, Peter Stone
arxiv-2406-12563.description: Abstract Racing autonomous cars faster than the best human drivers has been a longstanding grand challenge for the fields of Artificial Intelligence and robotics. Recently, an end-to-end deep reinforcement learning agent met this challenge in a high-fidelity racing simulator, Gran Turismo. However, this agent relied on global features that require instrumentation external to the car.

arxiv-2503-24225.title: Compressible N-phase fluid mixture models
arxiv-2503-24225.creator: M.F.P. ten Eikelder, E.H. van Brummelen, D. Schillinger
arxiv-2503-24225.description: Abstract Fluid mixture models are essential for describing a wide range of physical phenomena, including wave dynamics and spinodal decomposition. However, there is a lack of consensus in the modeling of compressible mixtures, with limited connections between different classes of models.

arxiv-2602-15238.title: Closing the Distribution Gap in Adversarial Training for LLMs
arxiv-2602-15238.creator: Chengzhi Hu, Jonas Dornbusch, David Lüdke, Stephan Günnemann, Leo Schwinn
arxiv-2602-15238.description: Abstract Adversarial training for LLMs is one of the most promising methods to reliably improve robustness against adversaries. However, despite significant progress, models remain vulnerable to simple in-distribution exploits, such as rewriting prompts in the past tense or translating them into other languages.

pmc-10604278.title: The Venular Side of Cerebral Amyloid Angiopathy: Proof of Concept of a Neglected Issue
pmc-10604278.creator: Marialuisa Zedde, Ilaria Grisendi, Federica Assenza, Gabriele Vandelli, Manuela Napoli, Claudio Moratti, Piergiorgio Lochner, David J Seiffge, Fabrizio Piazza, Franco Valzania, Rosario Pascarella, Brandon Lucke-Wold, Carmela Matrone
pmc-10604278.description: Small vessel diseases (SVD) is an umbrella term including several entities affecting small arteries, arterioles, capillaries, and venules in the brain. One of the most relevant and prevalent SVDs is cerebral amyloid angiopathy (CAA), whose pathological hallmark is the deposition of amyloid fragments in the walls of small cortical and leptomeningeal vessels.

pmc-10624870.title: Direct prediction of gas adsorption via spatial atom interaction learning
pmc-10624870.creator: Jiyu Cui, Fang Wu, Wen Zhang, Lifeng Yang, Jianbo Hu, Yin Fang, Peng Ye, Qiang Zhang, Xian Suo, Yiming Mo, Xili Cui, Huajun Chen, Huabin Xing
pmc-10624870.description: Physisorption relying on crystalline porous materials offers prospective avenues for sustainable separation processes, greenhouse gas capture, and energy storage. However, the lack of end-to-end deep learning model for adsorption prediction confines the rapid and precise screen of crystalline porous materials.

pmc-11482680.title: The value of using COVID-19 antibody tests as a potential approach to prioritize vaccination delivery
pmc-11482680.creator: Nasr Alrabadi, Haneen Obeidat, Razan Haddad, Noor Alyassin, Karem H. Alzoubi, Omar Obeidat, Saif M. Shteiwi, Daher Al-rabadi, Ibrahim Al-faouri
pmc-11482680.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). pmc-11607869.title: An epidemiological investigation of the prevalence of digestive diseases in the older prisoner population in Taiwan
pmc-11607869.creator: Zhu Liduzi Jiesisibieke, Ping Tao, Yen-Chun Wang, Ching-Wen Chien, Tao-Hsin Tung
pmc-11607869.description: ObjectiveThe prison population has been increasing globally, and prisoner health is an important issue of global health. However, it has not received sufficient attention, especially in developing countries and regions. Among all the prisoners, the health status of older prisoners requires special attention due to their declining health and energy.

pmc-12751787.title: Virtual reality intervention for visual perception in schizophrenia-a single blind pilot randomized controlled trial
pmc-12751787.creator: Berkan Torpil, Mehmet Cetinkaya
pmc-12751787.description: BackgroundSchizophrenia is characterized by both psychiatric symptoms and visual perception disorders. While virtual reality (VR) is increasingly used in schizophrenia rehabilitation, its impact on visual perception remains underexplored. This study aimed to investigate the effects of VR intervention on visual perception in schizophrenia.

pmc-12768794.title: PP46 Budget Impact Analysis Of Tafenoquine Following The G6PD Test For Treatment Of Plasmodium Vivax Malaria In The Brazilian Amazon
pmc-12768794.creator: Marcia Pinto, Ivan Zimmermann, Márcia Gisele Costa, Ana Carolina Carioca da Costa
pmc-12768794.description: IntroductionIn Brazil, approximately 99 percent of malaria cases are concentrated in the Amazon region, 68 percent of which are due to Plasmodium vivax. Tafenoquine, a single-dose drug, should be offered with a glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) test because it can cause severe hemolysis in patients with G6PD deficiency.

pmc-12785979.title: Last Aid Courses as a Means for Public Palliative Care Education—A Narrative Review of the Literature and 10 Years of Experience Around the World with Implications for Future Research
pmc-12785979.creator: Georg Bollig, Jason Mills, Sindy Müller-Koch, Pandeli Pani, Bianca Neumann, Erika Zelko
pmc-12785979.description: Objective: To provide a narrative overview of the scientific knowledge on Last Aid Courses and experiences from different countries. Background: The levels of death literacy, grief literacy, and knowledge about palliative care are low in many countries around the world. For many people, dying, death, and grief are still a taboo.

pmc-12800858.title: Number of Patient-Reported Allergies and Other Mental Health Measures Correlate With Symptom Severity at Time of Hip Arthroscopy for Femoroacetabular Impingement Syndrome
pmc-12800858.creator: Joshua T. Finerty, Nicholas R. Kossoff, Allison R. Garden, Joshua S. Everhart
pmc-12800858.description: PurposeTo determine whether patient-reported allergies (a proposed indirect measure of mental health) or direct measures of mental health are associated with preoperative symptom scores, as measured by the 12-item International Hip Outcome Tool (iHOT-12) in patients undergoing hip arthroscopy for femoroacetabular impingement syndrome.

pmc-13157373.title: Improved conductive carbon nanotube tape using natural cellulose fibrils for array tomography
pmc-13157373.creator: Minkyo Jung, Hyosun Choi, Chang Kee Lee, Ji Young Mun
pmc-13157373.description: Array tomography using scanning electron microscopy (SEM) enables large-volume, nanometer-scale reconstruction of neural circuits and allows nanometer resolution of synaptic vesicles and other ultrastructural features. For stable serial imaging, Kapton tape, carbon nanotube (CNT) tape mounted on silicon wafers, and indium tin oxide (ITO) glass have commonly been used.
